Cost of Studying abroad in Australia for Indian Students

Australian universities have seen a rapid increase in applications from India in recent years, owing to its world-class education, multicultural environment, and post-study career options offered for overseas students. As a country, it attracts students from all over the world for a variety of reasons. Australia, like all other countries, has some of the world’s greatest universities. These colleges’ advancement is aided by consistent innovation, strong professors, and high-quality education. While academics contribute to the call value, it may be the only country that has a pull due to its good living conditions and promise of great student life. When we decide to study abroad, one of the first questions we ask is, “How much does it cost to study in Australia?” You don’t have to be concerned! We understand that it is a significant expenditure, but with careful planning, you can realise your dream of studying abroad while staying within your budget. Don’t worry, we’ll cover most of your concerns about the Cost Of Studying Abroad In Australia For Indian Students in this blog.

Study Abroad Australia Tuition Fees

Tuition fees vary depending on the course of study and the institute. Australia has 40 public universities, two international universities, and one private university. For Indian students, education can be highly costly, costing up to $50000. Bachelor’s degree programmes cost between $20000 and $45000, while Master’s and PhD programmes cost between $22000 and $50000. Applicants should be aware that the cost of studying in Australia is closely proportional to the university chosen and the degree chosen. Applicants should be aware that these are estimates and are subject to change from time to time.

If you wish to reduce your educational costs, you could apply for one of the many scholarships offered to Indian students. Try researching about the Australia Awards, APEC Women in Research Fellowship Program and Endeavor PG Scholarship Awards. Apart from the aforementioned scholarships, various universities in Australia provide a variety of postgraduate and undergraduate scholarships to Indian students. Don’t worry if you get stuck somewhere; the education experts at One Window will be pleased to assist you.

    Study Abroad Australia Accommodation Costs

    Most Australian institutions provide on-campus housing for international students. You can also choose off-campus housing, where you can share an apartment with other Indian students or stay with an Australian family. Rent is normally paid in advance every two weeks. Keep in mind that rental prices differ from city to city.

      Hostels and Guesthouses- AUD 4320 – 7200 a year

      Shared Rental – AUD 4560 – 10320 a year

      On-campus – AUD 5280- 13440 a year

      Homestay- AUD 11280- 15600a year

        Boarding schools – AUD 11000 – 22000 a year

        Please keep in mind that the cost of living in Australia is highly dependent on the preferences and lifestyles of students. A luxury lifestyle would result in a high cost of living, whereas a moderate to modest lifestyle would result in lower costs of living.

          Miscellaneous Expenses

          While tuition costs in Australia account for the majority of international students’ expenses, we must also include other expenses that are directly tied to tuition costs.           General living expenses in Australia are $21,041 per year, according to the Australian government. An Indian student’s annual budget ranges from $20,000 to $27,00 (given your lifestyle choices). A student’s average annual travel expense is approximately AUD 2000.
